item.title: Woman's death highlights risks of relying on AI chatbots for mental health support
item.description: A 29-year-old shared her suicidal thoughts with ChatGPT instead of professionals. Her case raises concerns about AI's role in crisis situations.

item.title: Intense disputes emerge over revenue sharing in AI-generated music
item.description: AI can produce songs quickly, but determining who deserves payment and how much has sparked conflicts among stakeholders.

item.title: Recent graduates blame AI for job market struggles, but economists remain skeptical
item.description: New York Fed data shows higher unemployment among recent graduates than the overall rate. Whether AI is the cause is still debated.

item.title: Florida's crowded Republican primary features a diverse set of candidates
item.description: The GOP primary in Florida's 19th District includes newcomers to the state, repeat congressional hopefuls, and two candidates with notable backgrounds.
